intent.title: Zoom with the keyboard, the status bar buttons and Fit
steps: Press Ctrl+= three times, Ctrl+- once, Ctrl+0.
Click the zoom-in and zoom-out buttons and the zoom percentage.
Click Fit.
expected: Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- change zoom by 10 points, Ctrl+0 sets 100%; the iframe CSS zoom and the percentage in the status bar match.
Zoom stays between 10% and 800%; the page point at the centre of the canvas stays under the centre.
Clicking the percentage opens a menu with 25%, 50%, 100%, 200%, 400% and Fit.
Fit sets the zoom so the whole page width fits in the canvas and keeps it fitted when the canvas size changes; any manual zoom leaves Fit mode until Fit is chosen again.
The zoom (or Fit mode) is restored after a reload.

intent.title: Rotate an element with a handle on the canvas
steps: Select a Container.
Drag its rotation handle a quarter turn clockwise; repeat with Shift held.
Type 30 in the inspector's Rotate field.
Zoom to 200% and rotate again with the handle.
expected: A rotation handle sits outside the selection outline at a fixed screen distance; over it the cursor shows rotation.
Dragging rotates around the transform-origin and the angle follows the pointer; Shift snaps to 15° steps; the status bar shows the live angle.
The handle and the Rotate field run the same command and write the rotate property, never the transform list; a whole drag is one undo step.
The angle does not depend on the zoom; the outline and handles follow the rotated box.

intent.title: Ctrl+wheel zoom, wheel scroll and Space-drag pan
steps: Place the pointer over a heading and scroll the wheel with Ctrl held.
Scroll the wheel without modifiers, then with Shift.
Hold Space and drag the canvas.
expected: Ctrl+wheel zooms around the pointer: the heading stays under the pointer.
Wheel scrolls vertically and Shift+wheel horizontally; the page can be scrolled to see content below the fold.
Holding Space shows a grab cursor and dragging pans the view without selecting or moving anything; releasing Space returns to selection.

intent.title: Rulers along the canvas
steps: Look at the top and left rulers; zoom in and scroll.
Select an element.
Move the pointer over the page.
expected: The rulers fill the 20 px bands reserved along the top and left of the canvas; the canvas viewport and the page position do not move.
The rulers show page CSS px with 0 at the page top-left; labelled ticks sit on round values (10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500...) chosen so neighbouring labels are at least 40 screen px apart at any zoom.
They update with zoom and scroll.
The selected element's extent is highlighted on both rulers and a marker follows the pointer position.

intent.title: Create, move and delete guides from the rulers
steps: Drag from the top ruler down onto the page and release.
Drag from the left ruler onto the page and release.
Drag the horizontal guide to a new position.
Drag the vertical guide back onto its ruler.
Reload.
expected: Dragging out of the top ruler creates a horizontal guide and out of the left ruler a vertical guide, each labelled with its position in page px.
Guides can be moved; dropping a guide on its ruler deletes it.
Guides are stored per page in the document JSON, restored after reload and never exported; creating, moving and deleting guides are undo steps.

intent.title: Show element outlines and drop zones on the canvas
steps: Open Canvas tools and turn on Outlines.
Turn on Zones.
Turn both off.
expected: Outlines draw a dashed box around every element on the canvas.
Zones show the padding and empty drop areas of containers.
Neither changes the document JSON or the export; the choices are stored in preferences.

intent.title: Column grid, row grid and dot grid overlays
steps: Press Ctrl+'.
Press Ctrl+' again.
Turn on the row grid and the dot grid from the canvas tools.
expected: Ctrl+' toggles a 12-column grid overlay (1280 px wide, 24 px gutter, 80 px margin by default) drawn over the page at the right page coordinates.
The row grid draws horizontal bands and the dot grid draws dots, each at its default spacing.
Grid settings are stored per page in the document JSON and never exported.

intent.title: Guides & Grids settings dialog
steps: Open View > Guides & Grids.
Turn rulers and manual guides off and on.
Add a vertical guide at 400 by typing it.
Set the column grid to 6 columns, 960 width, 16 gutter, 40 margin; set row height and row gutter; set the dot spacing.
Close the dialog with Escape.
expected: The dialog has Visibility, Manual guides, Column grid, Row grid and Dot grid sections, each with an info tooltip.
Each change applies to the canvas immediately and is stored (visibility in preferences, grids and guides in the page).
Escape and the close button close the dialog and return focus to where it was.

intent.title: Free positioning of absolute children by dragging
steps: Insert a Section with a Heading; set the Heading position to absolute.
Drag the Heading 60 px right and 40 px down on the canvas.
expected: Setting absolute on a child of a static parent sets the parent to position relative and keeps the child's visual position (top/left computed from its old place).
Dragging an absolute child moves it freely; the status bar shows its coordinates relative to the parent; release writes top and left to the document JSON.
The measured position in the iframe equals the stored top and left.

intent.title: Nudge positioned elements with the arrow keys
steps: Select an absolutely positioned element on the canvas.
Press ArrowRight, Shift+ArrowDown, ArrowLeft three times quickly.
expected: For a selection that is absolutely or fixed positioned, arrows move the element by 1 px and Shift+arrows by 10 px instead of walking the tree; top/left in the document JSON change accordingly.
The status bar reads 'Moved to x, y' [status.movedTo].
A quick burst of nudges is one undo step.

intent.title: Anchor positioned elements to edges and centres
steps: Select an absolutely positioned element.
Press Alt+Shift+ArrowRight, Alt+Shift+ArrowDown.
Use the anchor control in the inspector to anchor horizontally to the centre.
Resize the parent.
expected: Alt+Shift+arrow toggles the anchor on that edge; anchoring both left and right stores left and right (width follows the parent).

Anchoring the centre stores left and right 0 with auto side margins and a fit-content width (top, bottom, auto margins and a fit-content height for the vertical centre), so the element stays centred without translate, which belongs to Move X/Y.
Toggling an anchor never moves the element visually; after resizing the parent the element keeps its distances to the anchored edges.

intent.title: Align and distribute positioned elements
steps: Place three absolutely positioned boxes in a positioned Container and select them.
Run Align left, Align centre and Align top; then Distribute horizontally.
Select one box and run Align centre.
expected: With several elements selected, align works on the selection's bounds; with one element, on its parent's box.
Distribute makes the gaps between the elements equal.
The commands are in the quick panel and the Arrange menu; top and left are written for each element as one undo step, and the measured positions in the iframe match.

intent.title: Snap on/off and snap settings
steps: Click 'Snap: Off' [topbar.snap.off] in the top bar.
Open the snap menu and choose Snap settings.
Untick Grid and Centers, set snap distance 10 and Apply; reopen and Cancel after changes.
expected: The top bar button toggles between 'Snap: Off' [topbar.snap.off] and 'Snap: On' [topbar.snap.on].
Snap settings lists Page, Parent, Elements, Guides, Rulers, Grid, Centers and Edges targets and a snap distance in px.
Apply stores the settings in preferences; Cancel discards changes.

intent.title: Snapping while resizing and moving positioned elements
steps: Turn snap on and add a vertical guide at x=400.
Resize a Container so its right edge passes near the guide.
Drag an absolutely positioned element so its left edge passes near another element's left edge and near the page centre.
Repeat holding Ctrl.
expected: Within the snap distance the edge jumps to the target and a snap line is drawn; the stored value is exactly the target position.
Only enabled targets snap.

Holding Ctrl suspends snapping for that gesture, when resizing and when moving; Alt keeps its one resize meaning, resizing from the centre, so each modifier has one meaning per gesture (report PG-14).

intent.title: Smart alignment and equal spacing guides
steps: Place three absolutely positioned boxes in a positioned container.
Drag one box so it aligns with the centre of another, then so the gaps between the three become equal.
In View > Guides & Grids turn Smart guides off and repeat.
expected: Alignment lines appear when edges or centres align with other elements.
Equal spacing markers appear when the gaps are equal and the box snaps to the equal-gap position when snap is on, using the snap distance from Snap settings (one setting).
The Guides & Grids dialog gains a Smart guides toggle under Visibility and an Equal spacing toggle; turning smart guides off removes these hints.

intent.title: Measure sizes and distances on the canvas
steps: Hover an element with nothing selected.
Select a Container, hold Alt and hover a sibling.
Hold Alt and hover the selection's parent.
Zoom to 50% and repeat.
expected: Hovering shows the element's size (W × H in CSS px) next to its hover outline.

With a selection, holding Alt over another element draws distance lines between the nearest edges, each labelled in CSS px; over an ancestor it shows the distances from the selection to the ancestor's inner edges.
The values are CSS px at any zoom and equal the measured geometry in the iframe.
Measuring never changes the selection or the document JSON.
